sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Yogesh Kumar Gupta, learned counsel for the appl  Shri Amit Bhatia, learned counsel for the respondent/
 ORDER

This is fourth application filed under section 439 of Cr.P.C in crime no.253/2022 under section 420,
406, 467, 468, 471 of IPC registered at police station Tukoganj Indore.

The first application was dismissed on merits by order dated 10.04.2023 considering the allegation against the applicant that the applicant who is a terminated employee had opened an account in the name of the Mega Builders company and made transactions from the said fraudulent account of rupees one crore sixty lakhs.
He has further entered into a forged agreement with the customers and got deposited in the said account amount of about Rs.80-85 lakhs.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the witnesses have deposed against the partner of the firm.
He further submits that there is no transaction by the applicant.

The aforesaid submission would not render any help to the case of the applicant as the allegations against the applicant are serious in nature which have already been considered while deciding the first application.
